Name: Tablet Deck
Description: Star Citizen controls through Tablet Deck: live key lights, press animations, dials and scenes, with Tablet Deck's focus check. Fan project, not affiliated with Cloud Imperium Games.

com.nodiecode.tabletdeck.key.Name: Deck Button
com.nodiecode.tabletdeck.key.Tooltip: Presses a Tablet Deck button through its focus check, with live lights.

com.nodiecode.tabletdeck.dial.Name: Deck Dial
com.nodiecode.tabletdeck.dial.Tooltip: One Tablet Deck press per detent; push or touch for a third button.

com.nodiecode.tabletdeck.scene.Name: Scene
com.nodiecode.tabletdeck.scene.Tooltip: Goes to a scene page of the Tablet Deck profile; tablets can follow.

com.nodiecode.tabletdeck.theme.Name: Theme
com.nodiecode.tabletdeck.theme.Tooltip: Draws every Tablet Deck key and dial in a manufacturer theme.

com.nodiecode.tabletdeck.talk.Name: Hold to Talk
com.nodiecode.tabletdeck.talk.Tooltip: Hold to speak a Tablet Deck voice command.

com.nodiecode.tabletdeck.status.Name: Status
com.nodiecode.tabletdeck.status.Tooltip: Shows the link to Tablet Deck and its round trip.

com.nodiecode.tabletdeck.lights.Name: Reset Lights
com.nodiecode.tabletdeck.lights.Tooltip: Turns off every lit key. Tablet Deck can't see the game, so lights only show what was pressed.

Localization.Presses go through Tablet Deck, which on: Presses go through Tablet Deck, which only sends keys while Star Citizen is in front.
Localization.Label: Label
Localization.One press per detent, at most 5 per turn: One press per detent, at most 5 per turn.
Localization.Goes to this scene's page in the Tablet: Goes to this scene's page in the Tablet Deck profile for this Stream Deck.
Localization.Every Tablet Deck key and dial is drawn: Every Tablet Deck key and dial is drawn in the theme you press.
Localization.Hold to speak a voice command; let go to: Hold to speak a voice command; let go to stop listening.
Localization.Shows the link to Tablet Deck: its round: Shows the link to Tablet Deck: its round trip, or what's wrong. Press it to try again.
